message: So, I was just reminiscing about the time we prepped for a storm that never came. I felt a bit silly at the time, but that smug 'I told you so' moment when the winds picked up? Priceless. 🌪️ If you're looking to channel that same energy, this resource from the Red Cross has some great tips on how to be ready for storms. Turns out, a little preparedness can go a long way. Have you ever found yourself over-prepared for a weather event? I'd love to hear your stories!
